executive_summary: Episode 115 alleges a PETN-explosives link between Mark A. Liti's 2022 burn-barrel death and Cory Comparato, killed at the Butler Trump rally, then bridges Liti's PETN access to the September 2024 Mossad Lebanon pager operation. The host documents a FOIA request for Kash Patel's Sept 7-10, 2025 schedule, the FBI 'unusual circumstances' delay response, and Blake Nef's X-post pushback. Erika Kirk's alleged anti-Israel statements to Tucker Carlson are surfaced in contrast to her post-assassination pro-Israel posture.
